# tricubic_interpolator_from_grid { #mofography.rust_fun.tricubic_interpolator_from_grid }

```python
rust_fun.tricubic_interpolator_from_grid(
    egrid8,
    extent_x=1.0,
    extent_y=1.0,
    extent_z=1.0,
)
```

Build a tricubic energy interpolator from an 8-channel energy grid.



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

egrid8 : ndarray, float64
    Shape (8, nx, ny, nz) in C order.
    Channel 0 = energy, 1-3 = ∂E/∂s_{x,y,z}, 4-7 = mixed ∂²E / ∂³E.
extent_x, extent_y, extent_z : float
    ASE fractional span per axis covered by ``egrid8`` (1.0 = full cell).
    Query coordinates in ASE ``[0, 1)`` map directly to the grid (no folding);
    extent is handled at grid-build time and in derivative scaling.



## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

TricubicField
    Rust-backed interpolator with ``.interpolate([fx, fy, fz]) -> float``
    and ``.interpolate_batch(fracs) -> ndarray`` methods.



## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

This is the Phase-1 evaluator only (no grid build). For the complete
pipeline (build + interpolate), see ``egrid_tricubic_from_atoms_rust``
(Phase 2, planned).
